v_1a40eaf445.speaker: walt
v_1a40eaf445.gen_text: Last night. The lamps may die.

v_ea111e9eaa.speaker: walt
v_ea111e9eaa.gen_text: Lights on you? Out of sight.

v_abc060cca7.speaker: walt
v_abc060cca7.gen_text: Long car? Window shut, or Mart.

v_79b511466d.speaker: walt
v_79b511466d.gen_text: Low on stock? Try the Mart.

v_7a64804dde.speaker: walt
v_7a64804dde.gen_text: Low on stuff? Try the Mart.

v_922fb14183.speaker: walt
v_922fb14183.gen_text: Messed up? Toss it. No harm.

v_146c67bf64.speaker: walt
v_146c67bf64.gen_text: Morning! Told you nights were quiet.

v_6a998d7bee.speaker: walt
v_6a998d7bee.gen_text: Morning, Rookie! I'm on the line.

v_fd74aa9897.speaker: walt
v_fd74aa9897.gen_text: Never let them reach your light.

v_f8d53173e0.speaker: walt
v_f8d53173e0.gen_text: New gear's on the trailer. Heh heh.

v_ee709edf63.speaker: walt
v_ee709edf63.gen_text: Nice! Cash goes in the drawer.

v_e983e4832e.speaker: walt
v_e983e4832e.gen_text: Night two. Check your food first.

v_6974dcd999.speaker: walt
v_6974dcd999.gen_text: No face at all? Just refuse.

v_28189fdbed.speaker: walt
v_28189fdbed.gen_text: Not what they asked. Toss it.

v_1ae72da760.speaker: walt
v_1ae72da760.gen_text: One Mister Pickett today, I hope.

v_089cce41c0.speaker: walt
v_089cce41c0.gen_text: Only chance I get. Be careful.

v_58bc970fcf.speaker: walt
v_58bc970fcf.gen_text: Potato sticks and a bigger grill.

v_e245baf6a4.speaker: walt
v_e245baf6a4.gen_text: Potato sticks today. Bigger grill, too.

v_0d3f6109b7.speaker: walt
v_0d3f6109b7.gen_text: Start today. Keys under the mustard.

v_e06f57adaa.speaker: walt
v_e06f57adaa.gen_text: Tap the frank box. Grill it.

v_9b07624221.speaker: walt
v_9b07624221.gen_text: They just want to be noticed.

v_deff9f6cab.speaker: walt
v_deff9f6cab.gen_text: They'll wander off. Grill stays hot.

v_455323adaa.speaker: walt
v_455323adaa.gen_text: We're open! Folks are lining up.

v_7150b19925.speaker: walt
v_7150b19925.gen_text: You work late tonight. I'll ring.

v_60345d932a.speaker: walt
v_60345d932a.gen_text: Call me if you need me.

v_3e91827b5e.speaker: walt
v_3e91827b5e.gen_text: That's the job. You got this.
